label: Cluster/ClusterEnvironment connection lifecycle
type: the connect/disconnect lifecycle of a Cluster and its shared ClusterEnvironment object - one Cluster instance intended to be created once and reused/shared across an application, not per-request
note: Minted in howtos/managing-connections.json; part of this round's connection-management family alongside sdk:managing-connections (the umbrella), sdk:tls-secure-connections and sdk:dns-srv-bootstrap, all independently at recurrence >= 2.
